poses.name: flinch
poses.intent: Flinch (reference f6-9, lowest f8; T90b: upper body strengthened per user 2026-09-25). Lower body as T90: COG down (CTRL_torso loc Y -0.015 -> -0.036, 21 mm below ready; legs IK planted), pelvis tipped forward 8 deg (without it the calf/pelvis and knee creases were visible from ~-0.03; -0.04 still gave a visible left knee crease 7 pairs and hip_flex_l 60.7). Upper body: clear forward curl spine_01 X 8 + chest X 9 (17 combined), head pitched down 14 (head lower and forward), protective hunch with shoulders raised (left Z 20, right Z -24.5 = up 24.5 (T91: -25 -> -24.5, C2 boundary float)), arms pulled in: left upper arm lowered to -52 and brought forward (X -20 -> -12), elbow 50; right upper arm lowered to 48 (twist -24) to offset the hunch. Lowering the upper arms further (-55 / 51) or bringing the right arm forward (X 12) opened a visible armpit crease (6 pairs). Right hand FK unchanged (DEF wrist bend 38.1). No scale; eyes cannot close (geometry).

Right hand FK unchanged. No squash/stretch.
